clips.title: The story
paras: Jordan's Smithing Hammer is a cherished family heirloom passed down to the human blacksmith Jordan Stilwell by his father. Its recovery from the haunted halls of Shadowfang Keep is essential for forging a holy weapon consecrated to the Light.

To an ordinary observer, Jordan's Smithing Hammer might seem like mere smith's iron, but to Jordan Stilwell, it represents both heritage and destiny. Inherited from his father, this tool is central to Jordan's identity as a forge master outside Ironforge. Having somehow wound up within the forsaken stone walls of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest, it must be reclaimed before Jordan can attempt his masterwork—a sacred weapon fit for a holy champion.
